text: 澳门特别行政区经济财政司9月7日上午在中国与葡语国家商贸合作服务平台综合体多功能厅举办《澳门特别行政区经济和社会发展第三个五年规划（2026—2030年）》经济财政范畴专场交流会。经济财政司司长吴惠娴率领经财团队各领导代表出席，约50名社团负责人和代表参与，聚焦“三五”规划中与经济适度多元发展相关的议题进行深入交流。金融管理局行政管理委员会主席黄善文表示，金管局将以债券市场、基金业务为主，服务经济适度多元；同时，将重点推进《证券法》、修改《货币发行法律制度》及相关法规，升级中央证券托管系统及快速支付系统等金融基建，并推动中葡金融服务平台建设、绿色金融发展
text_en: On the morning of September 7, the Macao SAR Secretariat for Economy and Finance held a special exchange session on the economic and financial chapter of the Third Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development of the Macao SAR (2026–2030) at the multifunctional hall of the China-Portuguese-speaking Countries Commercial and Trade Cooperation Service Platform Complex. Secretary for Economy and Finance Lei Wai Nong led the economic and financial team's leadership representatives, with around 50 heads and representatives of community associations participating, focusing in-depth exchanges on topics related to moderate economic diversification in the Third Five-Year Plan. Monetary Authority of Macao Administrative Committee Chairman Chan Sin Man stated that the authority will focus on the bond market and fund business to serve moderate economic diversification, while prioritizing the advancement of the Securities Law, amendments to the Legal Regime of the Issuance of Currency and related regulations, upgrading financial infrastructure such as the Central Securities Depository System and the Faster Payment System, and promoting the development of the China-Portuguese financial services platform and green finance.
